A smaller, more pocket-friendly version of the original Zero Tolerance 0454, the 0450 is a collaboration between ZT and custom knife designer Dmitry Sinkevich. With its two-tone Swedish blade steel and lightweight-yet-stronger-than-steel titanium handles, the 0450 has a sleek and sophisticated look that makes it a perfect EDC.

  • Compact design with all-titanium handle; built in the USA with American and global materials
  • S35VN sharpens to a razor edge, holds it, and can be resharpened easily; blade opens with KVT ball-bearing system
  • Polished pivot hardware; red-anodized aluminum tube spacers add a flash of color
  • Pocketclip is reversible for left- or right-handed carry; lanyard hole
  • Edition: Engravable
  • Type: Manual, Folder
  • Use: Everyday, Work
  • Style: Pocketknife
  • Designer: Dmitry Sinkevich
  • Blade Style: Drop Point
  • Blade Edge: Plain
  • Opening Action: Manual KVT ball bearings
  • Opens With: Flipper
  • Lock Type: Titanium frame lock, hardened steel lockbar insert
  • Pocketclip: Reversible (right/left, tip-up)
  • Country of Origin: Designed & Manufactured in the USA with American and Global Materials
  • Hardware: Steel pivot and pocketclip, red anodized tupe
  • Extras: Lanyard hole, custom pivot cap
  • Blade Steel: CPM S35VN, Swedish steel
  • Blade Length: 3.25 in. (8.3 cm)
